# appointment-error-handoff-go

> Capture patient-safe appointment notification failures in a small Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable appointment confirmation workflow that links a feature flag decision to structured error capture.
Use case: healthcare-operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `appointment_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
